purpose: Teach: 熊野/小澤/杉田/菅原/豊島/志村/川原/清原

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で熊野古道歩いてきたろ
lines.en: Riku, didn't you go walk the Kumano Kodo with your family?
lines.style: Quick, teasing dig. Opens bright. Leans forward slightly on his name. Eyebrow raise on the question mark — knowing he'll have to answer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、音楽の授業で小澤征爾の指揮見たろ、桜
lines.en: You watched Ozawa Seiji conducting in music class, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Calm parry. Matter-of-fact. Slight smile in the voice — he's deflecting smoothly, turning it back on her without heat. Measured pace, like he's been waiting to say this.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、保健の杉田先生に教わったろ
lines.en: Riku, didn't you have Mr. Sugita teaching you in health class?
lines.style: Faster now, slightly sharper. She's upping the tempo of the game. Bright attack on the question, like she's got him cornered and enjoying it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で菅原道真と天神様について調べたろ、桜
lines.en: You studied about Sugawara no Michizane and Tenjin in social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Even-keeled counter. Voice stays cool but there's a tiny thread of amusement underneath. He's keeping pace with her, throwing it right back. No rush.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のおじいちゃん、豊島区在住だったよな
lines.en: Riku, your grandfather lives in Toshima Ward, right?
lines.style: Shifts slightly — moving to personal territory now. Still playful but the dig goes a little deeper. Slight pause before the question, like she's checking his face.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お祖父ちゃんが志村けんファンだって言ってたな、桜
lines.en: Your grandfather was a fan of Shimura Ken, wasn't he, Sakura?
lines.style: Small, dry laugh underneath. He's going after something tender — using her own game against her. Voice stays light but there's a knowing edge to it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、林間学校で川原沿い歩いてたな
lines.en: Riku, you were walking along the riverbed during forest school camp, weren't you?
lines.style: Rebuilding momentum. Back to the bright tempo. She's searching now, less certain of where this is heading. Slightly breathless quality — the game is getting real.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、野球部で清原のホームラン研究してたろ、桜
lines.en: You were researching Kiyohara's home runs in the baseball club, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Tight, quick. Voice close and low — almost intimate in the teasing. He's moving in for something. Slight smile, but his eyes are locked. This one lands different.
